chapterInfo.content:
7
Onyankopɔn bu asase ne aman no atɛn
1Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 2Wo onipa ba, sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Israel asase nie:
Awieeɛ! awieeɛ na ɛreba
asase no ntwea nnan soɔ.
3Afei awieeɛ reba wo so,
na mɛsoma m’abufuo aba wo so,
na mabu wo w’akwan ho ntɛn,
na mede w’akyiwadeɛ nyinaa bɛba wo so.
4Na m’ani renni wo ho adɔna, na merenhunu wo mmɔbɔ,
na w’akwan na mɛma no aba wo soɔ,
na w’akyiwadeɛ atena wo mu,
na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE.
5Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie:
Adebɔne, adebɔne baako bi, hwɛ, ɛreba!
6Awieeɛ aba, awieeɛ no aba,
asɔre atia wo, hwɛ ɛreba!
7 # Yoel 1.15 Asase soteni, deɛ wɔahyɛ no
reba wo so;
ɛberɛ no aduru, ɛda no abɛn,
hooyɛ berɛ, na ɛnyɛ mmepɔ so anigyeɛ huro!
8Afei ɛrenkyɛre na mahwie m’abufuhyeɛ agu wo so,
na mawie m’abufuo wo mu,
na mabu wo w’akwan ho atɛn,
na mɛtea wo wɔ w’akyiwadeɛ nyinaa ho.
9Na m’ani rennodo wo ho, na merenhunu wo mmɔbɔ;
w’akwan ho ntea na mede bɛma woɔ,
na w’akyiwadeɛ atena wo mu,
na moahunu sɛ me, AWURADE na mebobɔ.
10 # Yes 10.5 Hwɛ, ɛda no nie, hwɛ, ɛreba;
deɛ wɔahyɛ no refifi,
aban no refefɛ, ahantan no ahanehane.
11Atiritirasɛm asɔre ayɛ abɔnefosɛm abaa;
wɔn ne wɔn asafo yuu
ne wɔn hooyɛ no mu hwee nka,
na yie biara nni wɔn mu.
12Ɛberɛ no aba, ɛda no rebɛn;
mma ɔdetɔfoɔ ani nnnye na ɔdetɔnfoɔ nnni abooboo,
na abufuhyeɛ no aba n’asafo yuu nyinaa so;
13 # Lew 15.2; Yer 48.37 na ɔdetɔnni, sɛ ɔda so te ase nso a, ɔrensane mma deɛ watɔn no ho, na adehunu a ɛfa n’asafo yuu nyinaa ho no rensane, na obiara remfa n’amumuyɛ nhyɛ ne nkwa mu den.
14Wɔhyɛne totorobɛnto na wɔsiesie ade nyinaa deɛ,
nanso deɛ ɔkɔ ɔsa nni hɔ;
na m’anibereɛ ba wɔn asafo yuu nyinaa so.
15Nkrantɛ wɔ mfikyire, na owuyadeɛ ne ɛkɔm wɔ efie.
Deɛ ɔwɔ wiram bɛwu nkrantɛ ano,
na deɛ ɔwɔ kuro mu no, ɛkɔm ne owuyadeɛ bɛkum no.
16Na wɔn mu adwanefoɔ firi mu a,
wɔbɛkɔ akɔtena mmepɔ so,
na wɔn nyinaa ayɛ sɛ mmonhwa mu mmuburo a wɔsisi apini,
obiara n’amumuyɛ ho.
17Nsa nyinaa mu bɛgogo,
na nkotodwe nyinaa ahono sɛ nsuo;
18na wɔafirafira ayitoma,
na awɔse agu wɔn so;
na aniwuo akata anim nyinaa, na wɔn nyinaa atifi bɛpa.
19 # Mmb 11.4; Sef 1.18 Wɔbɛtoto wɔn dwetɛ agugu mmorɔno so,
na wɔn sika adane sɛ sumina;
wɔn dwetɛ ne wɔn sika rentumi nnye wɔn AWURADE abufuo da no mu, wɔremfa mma wɔn kra mmee, na wɔremfa nhyɛ wɔn ayamdeɛ mu mama, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛɛ wɔn amumuyɛ ho suntidua. 20Na wɔn ahokekadeɛ fɛfɛ no, wɔde dii ahantansɛm, na wɔde yɛɛ wɔn akyiwadeɛ mfonini, wɔn atantanneɛ no, ɛno nti na mɛma no adane efi ama wɔn.
21Na mede bɛhyɛ ananafoɔ nsa, na wɔafom,
ne asase so abɔnefoɔ nsa, na ayɛ wɔn asadeɛ,
na wɔagu ho fi.
22Na mɛdane m’ani afiri wɔn so,
na wɔagu m’akoradeɛ ho fi,
na adwotwafoɔ bɛhyɛne mu
agu ho fi.
23Yɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn!
Na mogya ho atemmuo ayɛ asase no ma,
na atirimuɔden ahyɛ kuro no ma;
24enti mede amanaman nnipa bɔne bɛba,
na wɔbɛfa wɔn afiafi afa,
na mɛtwa ahoɔdenfoɔ ahantan to
ma wɔagu wɔn akronkronneɛ ho fi.
25Ɔsɛeɛ reba; na wɔhwehwɛ asomdwoeɛ,
nso ebi nni hɔ.
26Abuo pae abuo so,
akwansosɛm pae akwansosɛm so.
Na wɔhwehwɛ odiyifoɔ hɔ adehunu,
na mmara bɔ ɔsɔfoɔ,
na afotuo bɔ mpanimfoɔ.
27Ɔhene di abooboo,
na ɔberempɔn fira ahodwirie,
na asase no so aman aba mu abu.
Wɔn akwan ho adeɛ na mɛyɛ wɔn,
na wɔn atemmudeɛ na mede bɛbu wɔn atɛn,
na wɔahunu sɛ mene AWURADE.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
